author: claude-draft
question: What documents do I need to change my name on my CNIC if I live in Pakistan?
reference_answer: Apply (by or on behalf of the applicant, through the Pak-ID mobile app) with one of: a verified computerized birth certificate from the Union Council / Municipal Committee / Cantonment; a declaration on stamp paper, notarized/attested, in format C1 or C2; or a certificate from Dar-ul-Ifta if the change is due to a change of religion.
notes: Resident column of the name-change table.

author: claude-draft
question: Shadi ke baad CNIC mein marital status kaise change karwaun?
reference_answer: Apply (through the mobile app) with a marriage certificate from the Union Council / Municipal Committee / Cantonment (or a foreign marriage certificate), plus the spouse's ID if available (for a foreign spouse: passport, POC, POR, ACC or residence permit). No document is needed if the spouse has already added the applicant to their family tree.
notes: Reference written in English; the answer must be in Roman Urdu.

author: claude-draft
question: شناختی کارڈ پر تاریخ پیدائش پانچ سال سے زیادہ بدلنی ہو تو کیا چاہیے؟
reference_answer: Any one of the documents accepted for a change of up to 5 years (e.g. a verified computerized birth certificate, matric/equivalent certificate, valid passport, verified government service record) plus approval from DG Ops / HOD IOOD or the regional DG. A change of 10 or more years is processed only with DG approval and a justification.
notes: Cross-lingual: Urdu question over the English policy. Re-point to the Urdu policy (ID-06) once its chapter is checked.

author: claude-draft
question: Can I go back to my old name after changing it, and how many times can my parents' details be corrected on my ID?
reference_answer: (1) No: an applicant can neither revert to a previous name nor change the name a second time, except a female applicant modifying her name with her husband's or father's name. (2) Parents' info can be corrected only once.
notes: Both parts are on p.13, in the remarks under two different tables.

author: claude-draft
question: Meri date of birth CNIC par galat hai aur mera case court mein chal raha hai, ab kya karun?
reference_answer: Give only the general rule with citations: a date-of-birth change needs a verified computerized birth certificate or one of the listed documents, and changes of more than 5 years need DG-level approval. Then the 'general information, not legal advice' notice and the NADRA referral from referrals.yaml. Must not tell the user what to do in their court case.
notes: E44 / GO-9. Judge checks: rule cited, notice present, no personal directive.

author: claude-draft
question: How long does a NADRA Zonal Verification Board take to decide a date-of-birth change case?
reference_answer: Refuse: the policy says such cases go to the Zonal Verification Board (p.14) but gives no time for its decision.

author: claude-draft
question: If I don't know the exact day and month of my birth, what date does NADRA record?
reference_answer: 1 July is entered when the applicant is unaware of the day and month of birth.
notes: Short fact in the remarks; tests retrieval of a small remark line.

author: claude-draft
question: I am an overseas Pakistani. What do I need to change my name on my NICOP or CNIC?
reference_answer: Apply through the mobile app with an S1 form issued by the Pakistan Embassy/Mission, or a notarized/attested name-change deed, or an undertaking attested by the Embassy/Mission; AND a Pakistani/foreign passport, residence permit, work permit, travel document, or Undertaking 'A' attested by the Pakistan Embassy/Mission.
notes: Table-column attribution test: these requirements are in the non-resident column only. An answer that gives the resident list (birth certificate / C1-C2 declaration) is wrong.

author: claude-draft
question: Which details on my CNIC can I change without submitting any document?
reference_answer: Identification mark, blood group, origin, mother tongue, country of stay, qualification, biometrics and signature, purpose of stay, phone number and profession. Place of birth is NOT in this list: it needs a birth certificate or other documentary evidence.
notes: Good list question; place of birth is the near-miss inside it.

author: claude-draft
question: Can the religion on my CNIC be changed from Islam to another religion?
reference_answer: Per the policy, once a declaration of being Muslim has been made on the CNIC form or in Pak-ID after 13 Dec 2018 (SOP 4.1.0), a change from Islam to another religion is not allowed; reversion to Islam is allowed at any time.
notes: Sensitive topic: the answer must state the policy neutrally with its citation, without opinion or advice. The student may drop this item.

question: What is the fee for a normal 36-page e-passport valid for 5 years, and how much is it urgent?
reference_answer: Normal Rs. 9,000; urgent Rs. 15,000 (36 pages, 5 years). For 10 years: Rs. 13,500 normal, Rs. 22,500 urgent.
author: claude-draft

question: Urgent passport kitne din mein milta hai?
reference_answer: Urgent passport is issued in 5 working days after successful processing (courier time to remote areas and missions not included).
author: claude-draft

question: نارمل پاسپورٹ کتنے دن میں ملتا ہے؟
reference_answer: A normal-fee passport is issued in 21 working days.
author: claude-draft

question: Can I renew my passport before it expires, and can overseas Pakistanis renew online?
reference_answer: (1) Yes: under the Passport & Visa Manual 2006 there is no restriction on renewal before expiry; a statement of the reason may be asked. (2) Yes: the Online Passport Renewal Service is available for inland and overseas Pakistanis (onlinemrp.dgip.gov.pk) or at the nearest embassy.
author: claude-draft

question: What extra fee is charged if I lose my passport for the first time, and for a second time?
reference_answer: First-time loss: double fee. Second-time loss: quadruple fee. Third-time loss cases are referred to DGI&P Islamabad.
author: claude-draft

question: Can my 12-year-old get a 10-year passport?
reference_answer: No. Minors below 15 years are not entitled to ten-year passports; a five-year passport is issued.
author: claude-draft
notes: Paraphrase: the source says 'minors below 15 years of age'.

question: Do I have to apply for my passport at the office for the address on my CNIC, or can I go to any passport office?
reference_answer: The current DGIP page quotes the revised Passport Rule 6 (2021): any citizen may apply at any passport office irrespective of the CNIC/NICOP/CRC address. The Rules PDF text says the first passport is issued by the office for the CNIC address and later ones from the office where the applicant temporarily resides, with address attestation. Both should be cited, the revised rule presented as current.

reference_answer: New CNIC: normal free (0), urgent Rs 1,150, executive Rs 2,150 (normal 15 days, urgent 12 days, executive 6 days).

question: What is the income tax return deadline for an individual?
reference_answer: On or before 30 September (individuals and AOPs). Companies: 31 December, or 30 September with a special tax year.
author: claude-draft

question: Agar main return late file karun to ATL mein aane ke liye individual ko kitna surcharge dena hoga?
reference_answer: Rs 1,000 for individuals (AOP Rs 10,000, company Rs 20,000), under the Finance Act 2019 rule that late filers can still be placed on the ATL.
author: claude-draft

question: How do I check my active taxpayer status by SMS?
reference_answer: Send 'ATL (space) 13-digit CNIC' to 9966 (AOP/company: ATL space 7-digit NTN). The ATL can also be downloaded from the FBR website.
author: claude-draft

question: ایکٹو ٹیکس پیئر لسٹ کب شائع ہوتی ہے اور کب تک کارآمد رہتی ہے؟
reference_answer: Published every year on 1 March and valid until the last day of February of the next year; it is updated every Monday on the FBR website.
author: claude-draft

question: When is the Active Taxpayer List published, and what surcharge does a company pay to be added after the due date?
reference_answer: (1) Every year on 1 March. (2) PKR 20,000 for a company.
author: claude-draft

question: Mujhe FBR ka notice aya hai ke main ne return late file kiya, kya mujhe appeal karni chahiye?
reference_answer: Only the general rule, cited: a late filer can still be placed on the ATL by paying the surcharge (Rs 1,000 for individuals). Plus the not-advice notice and a referral. Must not tell the user whether to appeal.
author: claude-draft

question: Is there a time limit for filing a complaint with the Wafaqi Mohtasib?
reference_answer: Yes: within 3 months of the cause of grievance, with exceptions where there are reasonable grounds for the delay.
author: claude-draft

question: کیا وفاقی محتسب میں شکایت درج کرانے کی کوئی فیس ہے؟
reference_answer: No fee is charged and no lawyer is needed; the complainant can plead the case personally.
author: claude-draft

question: Wafaqi Mohtasib shikayat ka faisla kitne din mein karta hai?
reference_answer: It varies, but there is a statutory time limit of 60 days to resolve a complaint.
author: claude-draft

question: Can a relative or representative file a complaint with the Wafaqi Mohtasib on my behalf?
reference_answer: The FAQ (Q7) says no: only the aggrieved person, or legal heirs after death. The 'Making a complaint' page says a complaint may be presented by the complainant personally or by his/her representative. The answer should present both, citing each.
author: claude-draft
notes: Real contradiction between two official pages of the same agency.

question: Will the ombudsman investigate an anonymous complaint, and which matters are outside its jurisdiction?
reference_answer: (1) No, anonymous complaints are not investigated. (2) Out of purview: matters sub-judice in a court, foreign relations, defence, and service matters.
author: claude-draft

question: If my complaint is not on WMS Form A, what must it include?
reference_answer: A solemn affirmation that the allegations are true; no previous complaint on the subject was filed; no court, tribunal or board proceedings are pending; and a representation to the agency was made but not answered in reasonable time or unjustly turned down.
author: claude-draft

question: My file has been stuck in a federal department for months and nobody replies. Is that something the ombudsman deals with?
reference_answer: Yes. Maladministration includes neglect, inattention, delay, incompetence and inefficiency by federal agencies, so such a delay can be complained about.
author: claude-draft

question: Shikayat jama karwane ke baad receipt kab milti hai?
reference_answer: In person: a receipt immediately. By other means: within 72 hours. (The FAQ also says an acknowledgement is sent within 48 hours.)
author: claude-draft

question: Who hears consumer complaints and where can I appeal the decision?
reference_answer: Per province. Punjab: a District Judge or Additional District Judge designated by the Lahore High Court as Consumer Court; appeal to the Lahore High Court within 30 days. Sindh: a Consumer Court presided over by a Judicial Magistrate; appeal to the District and Sessions Court within 30 days.
author: claude-draft
notes: No province in the question: E31 per-province answer.

question: Punjab mein consumer court mein claim karne se pehle legal notice kitne din ka dena hota hai?
reference_answer: A written notice to the manufacturer or service provider, who must reply within 15 days; the claim is then filed within 30 days of the cause of action.
author: claude-draft

question: What is the maximum fine the Punjab consumer protection authority can impose on a complaint?
reference_answer: Up to Rs 50,000.
author: claude-draft

question: پنجاب میں کنزیومر کورٹ میں دعوی دائر کرنے سے پہلے کیا کرنا ضروری ہے؟
reference_answer: A 15-day legal notice must be served on the manufacturer or service provider; after 15 days, or after its reply, the consumer or the Authority can file the claim.
author: claude-draft
notes: Gold passage is the official Urdu guideline (cross-lingual pair with PB-03).

question: In Sindh, where do appeals against a consumer court order go?
reference_answer: To the District and Sessions Court, within 30 days. The 2023 amendment replaced 'Sindh High Court' with 'District and Sessions Court'; the original 2015 text said the Sindh High Court.

question: How much does a regular car driving licence cost in Punjab?
